title: Board Bounded Drag In Selection Bounds
description: Fix board bounded drag: at minimap and overview LOD, dragging should work when clicking anywhere inside the selected items' bounding rectangle without requiring a discrete node hit. Minimap already skips discrete hits; overview and pointer-down path need bounded drag begin before marquee selection.
summary: Implemented minimap/overview bounded drag: pointer-down inside the padded union AABB of the current selection starts a group DragNodes without a discrete hit. Overview LOD now skips discrete picks like minimap. Added Rust unit tests and a Vitest headless test for overview bounded drag.
